text:
ana_muchado: Heads-up — modeling shows our EU hosted fleet runway tilts negative if current embed-heavy app traffic continues. sharing a quick snapshot.
samir: ugh, saw a few alerts yesterday about queue depth spikes. how bad is the tilt?
ana_muchado: rough numbers: with current committed GPU hours we hit 85% capacity by next Tue under P50 demand. P90 crosses committed by Thursday.
kevin_h: can you drop the query you used? want to sanity-check the shape.
ana_muchado: sure — bq snippet I used:
```
SELECT hour, sum(gpu_hours) as used FROM `redwood.billing.hosted_usage`
WHERE region='eu' AND model_family IN ('embed','large-gen')
AND ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour
```
lizzy_ops: also saw a billing blip in the daily reserved usage report — some instances counted as on-demand for a few hours yesterday.
billing-bot: [automated] Reservation mismatch detected: reservation_id=rv-9f3c, delta_hours=+14.2
samir: that mismatch could explain the extra burn. Kevin, can we reconcile reservation assignments vs autoscaler churn?
kevin_h: yep — looks like 2 hosts didn't attach to reservation due to kubelet restart around 03:12 UTC. I have logs.
ana_muchado: attaching small table from the forecast run (P50/P90/Current):
```
P50: runway 7 days
P90: runway 3 days
Current burn rate: +18% week-over-week
Known incidents: reservation detachment 03:12 UTC
```
lizzy_ops: action idea: short-term hedge with one-day committed capacity (cloud provider supports 24h reservations) + enable cluster sticky-attach to reservations.
samir: +1 for sticky attach. For 24h reservation — how quick to provision and what's cost delta vs burst credits?
kevin_h: provider API shows instant provisioning but billing pro-rates. Cost wise, 24h reservation ~10% cheaper than on-demand for same hours, but we pay upfront for the 24h block.
ana_muchado: alternative: shift low-priority batch embed jobs to off-peak EU window for 48h; that buys runway without extra reservation spend.
lizzy_ops: can we throttle or route newly onboarded embed jobs to US region temporarily? latency impact for EU customers may be acceptable for non-SLA cohorts.
samir: need to vet privacy/regulatory constraints — some customers require EU-only. We should flag those to product.
ana_muchado: added a quick breakdown of customers >=1k qps that are EU-only: cust-A, cust-C, cust-D.
kevin_h: for immediate triage I'll patch kubelet auto-attach and create a monitoring alert for reservation attach failures (threshold: >1 host detach in 30m).
capacity-bot: [automated] New forecast job started: forecast_id=fc-20240301-71
lizzy_ops: action items:
- Kevin: fix kubelet attach + alert (owned)
- Samir: run customer routing opt-in check and flag sensitive customers (owned)
- Ana: run cost/hedge calc for 24h reservation vs burst credits and post numbers (owned)
- Ops: propose emergency runbook step to shift low-priority embed jobs to off-peak (owned)
samir: timeline?
kevin_h: kubelet patch + alert in next 2 hours, will test on canary cluster first.
ana_muchado: I'll post the cost delta by EOD and include a small sensitivity table (if demand +10%/+20%).
lizzy_ops: putting a calendar check — emergency capacity sync at 09:30 UTC tom.
samir: thumbs-up. Also, can billing team confirm the reservation delta hours mapping to invoice SKUs? yesterday's +14h might already be invoiced.
billing-bot: [automated] Invoice check queued: invoice-2024-03-29 -> possible SKU mismatch flagged, assigning to @billing-team.
ana_muchado: final note: if P90 trajectory doesn't change, we should consider short-term committed buy + scheduling shift. prefer minimal spend until we confirm churn/attach fixes.
kevin_h: agreed. will report back in-thread once attach alert is live and canary passes.
lizzy_ops: thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
